headline: Stock Markets Tumble, Sensex Crashes 1,312 Points While Nifty Slips Below 23,900 Amid Broad Selling
summary: Indian benchmark indices closed sharply lower as heavy selling in banking, financial and IT shares dragged them down. The BSE Sensex fell over 1,300 points while weak global cues added pressure.
why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty are India's main benchmark indices, tracking large listed companies across banking, financial services and technology.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: Broad selling across banking, financial and IT shares pulled the benchmark index lower.
